_what: Problem reports sent from this computer (computer/sampled-report.mjs). `kinds` says how many reports of a kind are sent: `rate` is the share of launches that send (0 to 1), decided on this computer from the install and the launch so the same launch always decides the same way. `sinks` are where reports go: a sink may hold only an address and an ingest identifier, and its `scope` must be `ingest` (an identifier that can write a report and read nothing back). A sink row that holds anything else is refused when it is read. `scrub` rows remove this person's own paths and names from a report before it leaves.

words.sink_scope: The sink {id} is not scoped to ingest, so it was not read.
words.sink_field: The sink {id} holds {field}, which a shipped sink may not hold.
words.sink_url: The sink {id} is not an https address.
words.no_sink: No sink is set up for {kind} reports.
words.unknown_kind: There is no report kind named {kind}.
